summary: At commit 0c5a3f37453813743aa387f0f861a4b523321d7d, the previously fixed unrestricted prompt no longer leads the queue; the first boundary is step 45. The hero's l move enters an unseen rust trap. C hack.c:spoteffects() triggers dotrap() and trap.c:trapeffect_rust_trap(); the recorded rn2(5)=3 selects the default body splash, emits 'A gush of water hits you!', and applies water/splash effects before continuing. JS requireSimpleHeroDestination() calls preflight_dotrap() and rejects rust before the move, while trapeffect_selector() also routes RUST_TRAP to the generic refusal. Port the whole source function (hero and monster arms), admit RUST_TRAP, and preserve C evaluation, random-call, and side-effect order.

source.branch: The trap is RUST_TRAP and C's mtmp == &gy.youmonst hero arm is reached from an ordinary committed movement. In this recording the trap is unseen, Polly is an unpolymorphed human without flight or levitation, and the floor_trigger()/check_in_air() and seen-trap escape gates therefore pass. trap.c:1610 rn2(5)=3 selects the default body arm: it prints the water-hit message, splashes lit carried objects except the primary and secondary weapon, then forced-water-damages cloak, suit, or shirt and updates inventory. The source function's complete file-port scope also includes its head, left-arm, right-arm, and monster arms, including iron-golem death and gremlin split branches.

nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:dotrap() (2996-3060) and trapeffect_selector() (2937-2992) dispatch the hero arm; js/trap_effects.js:dotrap() (2266-2319) and trapeffect_selector() (2152-2185) are their production counterparts.

js/trap_water_damage.js:water_damage() is the existing hero item-water owner but still fail-closes unported lit-item and several water branches; water_damage_monster_equipment() (37-75) is the existing forced monster-equipment adapter, with js/trap_erode_obj.js:erode_obj() and js/apply_splash_lit.js:splash_monster_light() beneath it.

js/mondata.js:completelyrusts() (1600-1602) and js/mon.js:monkilled() (4621-4668) cover the monster iron-golem death test; split_mon() remains an explicitly unported C dependency for gremlins and must be recorded as a discarded-result gap if not in scope.
js/trap_effects.js:UNPORTED_TRAP_EFFECTS (2128-2136) and preflight_dotrap() (2211-2216) are the admission/refusal guards that must be updated together with selector dispatch.
